title: GRASP: A Disagreement Analysis Framework to Assess Group Associations in Perspectives
models_tested: No specific models were tested. The paper analyzes human annotation data collected on the output of a generative AI-chatbot (LaMDA, based on the reference to Thoppilan et al., 2022).
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It proposes a framework to analyze rater disagreement in subjective tasks (safety and offensiveness) based on socio-demographic axes like race, gender, age, and geo-cultural region.
